text:
Elaine: Pasting the new left-rail mock — trying a compact ‘zones’ approach. Idea is to group Models + Serving under one parent and move Account/Settings into a separate profile cluster. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx (mock A)
Sam K: I like grouping for reducing vertical noise, but worried about discoverability for Dedicated customers who expect a "Serving" entry. Can we surface Serving in the quick action menu? @Elaine :thinking_face:
Maria P: Accessibility nits: breadcrumbs should have `aria-current="page"` and we need a skip-to-main link when left-rail collapses. Also deep links need to focus the heading after navigation (focus management).
Jun: Routing nit: prefer canonical path style over query params. e.g. `GET /console/models/:modelId/overview` instead of `/console?view=model&modelId=xxx`. This keeps permalinks stable.
Jun: Small example for route matching we talked about:
```
/console/models/(?<id>[^/]+)(?:/(overview|metrics))?
```
Nicole: Agree with Jun. Also request: support aliases for legacy URLs so bookmarks don't 404 — we can add a small middleware that 301s old query-based links to the new path. For example netlify-style rule:
```
/console?view=model&modelId=:splat  301  /console/models/:splat
```
Sam K: UX concern — if we collapse too much, power users will be three clicks away from deployment logs. What about a configurable compact mode (user preference) where we show more items for users on Dedicated plans?
Maria P: Also copy tweak: instead of "Models & Serving" maybe "Models • Serving" or split visually with a thin divider — helps scanning. And microcopy on hover should include keyboard shortcut hints.
Elaine: Good call on both — I'll prototype a 2-level hover menu and a compact-mode toggle. Also thinking about deep-link hash anchors for pane state, e.g. ` /console/models/abc#kv-cache` so linkable subpanes work.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: nav-prototypes/1769832100 -> staging at 1769832300 :rocket:
Sam K: One more thought — breadcrumbs: show root > workspace > models > <model-name>. If we add "Serving" under the same parent, breadcrumbs should not repeat the parent name twice.
Maria P: a11y test: when a deep link lands on a tabbed pane, ensure `role="tabpanel"` receives `tabindex="-1"` and gets focused. I'll add this to the checklist.
Nicole: Implementation note: add a short-lived redirect map in the routing layer and emit a deprecation header so clients can migrate.
Elaine: Sweet. I'll iterate the figma, update the prototype, and run a 5-user quick test next week. Thanks everyone :heart:
